title: He said also how at the end of the second month a human soul was infused
html_source:
Here Stephen tells his theory that at the end of the second month of life, infants are given a soul.

Present, is Leopold Bloom, who would find this theory particularly painful, having lost his son Rudy ten days into his young life.
